hook: $46.99 for the drawer that fixed my dark cabinet

scenes.visual_prompt: Opening a deep base cabinet door to reveal a dark cavity with canned goods stacked out of sight
scenes.voiceover: A base cabinet that's 24 inches deep hides everything past the first 8 inches. That's where my canned goods went to disappear.

scenes.visual_prompt: Hand reaching blindly into the back of the cabinet, knocking cans over
scenes.on_screen_text: Flats don't belong on a lazy Susan
scenes.voiceover: Costco cans come in 6- or 8-can flats, and flats don't work on a turntable. They need a drawer you can pull all the way out.

scenes.visual_prompt: Installing the PXRACK expandable pull-out drawer organizer into the cabinet, adjusting the width
scenes.voiceover: The PXRACK Expandable Under-Sink Organizer with 2 Pull-Out Drawers is $46.99, 4.7 stars, 1,773 reviews, and it expands to fit most standard cabinet openings.

scenes.visual_prompt: Pulling the drawer all the way out, showing full rows of canned goods visible from front to back
scenes.on_screen_text: It's about the depth, not the mess
scenes.voiceover: It's marketed for under-sink cabinets, but reviewers keep using it in pantries for exactly this — bringing the back row forward instead of reaching in blind.

scenes.visual_prompt: Closing the drawer smoothly, cabinet now fully organized and visible at a glance
scenes.voiceover: It's the priciest thing on my list, but it's solving a problem the turntable and containers can't — depth.

caption: $46.99 for a drawer meant for under-sink cabinets that works just as well hiding my canned goods problem in the base pantry cabinet. 1,773 reviews, 4.7 stars. Full breakdown in bio.
